stem: Let ω1=θ̇1 and ω2=θ̇2 denote shoulder and elbow angular rates, and h=l1l2(m2/2+m3+m4)sinθ2 the source model’s coupling coefficient. If ω2=0 while ω1≠0 and h≠0, what follows from V1=−h(2ω1ω2+ω2²) and V2=hω1²?

options.text: Both V1 and V2 must be zero

assumptions: l1,l2 are horizontal link lengths in metres; m2,m3,m4 are link/distal masses in kilograms; θ2 is the elbow angle; h has units kg·m² and ω1,ω2 use rad/s.
